stepTitle: Elevate the rear of your LENOVO ThinkPad T15 Gen 1: Prop up the back rubber feet by 0.5–1 inch (using small rubber risers or an angled laptop stand). Raising the bottom intake vents off the desk surface immediately drops peak CPU temperatures by 8°C–15°C.
